summary: The sync notes congratulate new committer Maximilian Michels and list recent merges across Java, Python, Rust, Go and C++, including a v4 manifest reader, vectorized Parquet reads for variant in Spark, and REST spec changes for VariantType, remote signing configuration and expressions. Neelesh gave a Java 1.12 release update, and Rust 0.10.0 and 0.10.1 are released. Discussion items were the shared testing repository proposal, the vector type proposal, a unique files spec clarification, V4 scope, and virtual community meetups and showcases. The PRs-to-review list repeats earlier requests and adds an item from Huaxin on deprecating equality deletes in V4. The notes record agenda items without outcomes.

topics.title: Highlights
topics.summary: Maximilian Michels is a new committer. Java merges include a v4 manifest reader, geometry and geography values in Avro, a streaming merge append write config and vectorized Parquet reads for variant in Spark, a Flink variant Avro record generator, and REST spec changes adding VariantType, formalizing remote signing configuration and aligning expressions with the new expressions spec. PyIceberg added a ParquetFormatModel using the format API, zstd Puffin blobs and basic assumptions in AGENTS.md. Iceberg Rust and Go continued encryption, Puffin and deletion vector work, and Rust added variant support. Iceberg C++ added merging of deletion vectors, row lineage support and metrics.
